text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed an appeal from the owner of 356 Bartlett Avenue North for front yard parking. Front yard parking at this location is not recommended because it does not meet the criteria of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 918. The Code does not permit the licensing of a front yard parking pad where neighbourhood polling yielded a negative result.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the item until its May 22, 2019 meeting.
